Hello Phillip,

Yes, the change is fine, nothing has shipped yet.

Your order now ships to Phillip W., (address hidden), Chile. That is on the order itself.

One part is still open: our warehouse keeps its own copy of the ship-to, and that copy would not take the new address from my side. I don't want to tell you it is fully done when it isn't. A colleague picks it up tomorrow from 10am Eastern and updates the warehouse copy, and you will get the confirmation by email. Nothing can leave the warehouse before then, so the parcel is in no danger of going to the old address.

On the shipment itself, the Magic Miner 40T with the Miner Duster and Power Kit is still unshipped, and the new date is with the team as well. You can follow the batch on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sorry for the extra step on this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
